findings.claim: Signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at the observed selection nodes are dominated by the local_cyy component: all 20 landmark regions show positive enrichment_z for local_cyy (effect_z 0.19-0.67), with q-values at or below 0.0166 and positive_batch_fraction 0.79-1.0. This is a selection-enrichment contrast, not an absolute geometric descriptor.

The local_cxx component is the second consistently signed favorable contrast across the observed window: all 20 landmark regions show positive enrichment_z (effect_z 0.18-0.58), with q-values at or below 0.099 and positive_batch_fraction 0.71-0.93.

The local_dy component shows a mixed but predominantly positive signed contrast: 13 of 20 landmark regions have positive enrichment_z (effect_z 0.13-0.53), while regions 2, 6, 9, 14 and 18 show negative enrichment_z (effect_z -0.32 to -0.43). The sign is therefore region-dependent rather than uniform.

The soft_mass component is not a consistent signed favorable contrast: enrichment_z is positive in 13 of 20 regions but negative in regions 0, 7, 10, 13, 17 and 19 (effect_z -0.06 to -0.48), with several q-values above 0.05.

The local_dz component is the weakest and least consistent signed contrast: enrichment_z is positive in only 9 of 20 regions and negative in 11, with effect_z magnitudes mostly below 0.31 and many q-values above 0.05.

The off-diagonal local_cxy and local_cxz components show no consistent signed favorable contrast across the observed window: enrichment_z signs alternate by region and most q-values exceed 0.05, so these components are not supported as directional selection signals in this evidence.
The local_cyz component is predominantly positive but weaker than local_cyy and local_cxx: 19 of 20 regions have positive enrichment_z (effect_z 0.01-0.37), with several q-values above 0.05.

The enrichment_change_rate_z measure over the observed window does not reproduce the stable signed pattern seen in enrichment_z: for local_cyy the change-rate effect_z is negative in 12 of 20 regions, and for soft_mass it is negative in 11 of 20, indicating that the rate-of-change contrast is not equivalent to the level contrast.

The parent_edge_contrast_rate_z measure shows large positive local_cxx and local_cyy effects in many regions (effect_z up to 5.1 and 5.9 respectively) but with wide confidence intervals that cross zero in several regions, so it is a distinct contrast statistic rather than confirmation of the enrichment_z result.

The population, label and observable are bound as follows: the population is the observed selection nodes grouped into 20 landmark regions; the label is the recorded favorable-versus-comparison enrichment contrast (recorded affinities removed, equal score prior); the observable is the native model endpoint world coordinate components (soft_mass, local_dx, local_dy, local_dz, local_cxx, local_cyy, local_czz, local_cxy, local_cxz, local_cyz) at those nodes.

The local_cyy enrichment contrast is a selection-enrichment statistic (enrichment_z) and must not be interpreted as an absolute geometric descriptor or as a physical interaction energy; the supplied evidence contains no absolute geometric baseline for these components.

hypotheses.claim: The consistent positive local_cyy enrichment contrast across all 20 landmark regions may reflect a shared favorable-versus-comparison coordinate signature at the observed selection nodes, but this diagnostic cannot establish causation or a physical interaction energy.

limitations: Only regional contrast evidence is supplied in this isolated interface probe.
Transformed copies are never production evidence or inputs to compilation.
Decoded terminal learning labels are not available; recorded affinities were removed with an equal score prior.
The supplied evidence is diagnostic_only with a sign_changed transformation and is never used for generation.
No current study outcome data are available to the Analyst role.

The regional_effects table reports enrichment_z, enrichment_change_rate_z and parent_edge_contrast_rate_z contrasts; none of these is an absolute geometric descriptor or a physical interaction energy.
Temperature is an immutable task parameter; no temperature edit is proposed or supported by this evidence.
